items.title: How to Decide What Work AI Should Do for You: The AI Deputization Audit
items.summary: Two new features — GrokBot's teach-a-task and ChatGPT's Computer History — mark the moment the AI bottleneck officially moved from capability to context. But once your AI can learn how you work, you still have to decide what work it should actually do. NLW proposes a scoring system: the AI deputization audit.
items.whyItMatters: Infrastructure news is the supply side of AI: chips, memory, and hosting constraints quietly decide what tools can exist and what they cost.

brief.whatHappened: How to Decide What Work AI Should Do for You: The AI Deputization Audit

items.title: Mastercard took down payments across Australia with a scheduled update
items.summary:

items.title: Qwen is the world’s most downloaded open model, by a smaller margin than Alibaba says
items.summary:
Alibaba says its Qwen models have passed 3 billion downloads, making them the most used open-weight family in the world. The Hugging Face report published a day earlier counts 2,045 million for Qwen this year, and 151,448 derivatives against Alibaba’s claim of more than 300,000.
